purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for one whole-Agenda replacement, preserving accepted revision and ordered Agenda snapshot without becoming Event domain identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person scoping the operation id.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef; technical operation scope does not become Event ownership semantics beyond the accepted self boundary.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Caller-supplied idempotency identity for one Agenda mutation attempt stream.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed non-empty text up to 200 characters.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: SHA-256 fingerprint of Event ref, expected revision and normalized ordered Agenda values.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.meaning: Event whose Agenda mutation was accepted.

columns.name: expected_revision
columns.meaning: Aggregate Agenda revision supplied by the caller as the CAS precondition.

columns.name: resulting_revision
columns.meaning: Aggregate Agenda revision accepted by this mutation.

columns.name: accepted_agenda_parts
columns.meaning: Ordered Agenda value snapshot accepted by this operation for exact idempotent replay.
columns.value_contract: At most 100 normalized values; typed operation snapshot, not generic JSON or a second canonical Agenda store.

columns.name: created_at
columns.value_contract: statement_timestamp recorded in the same transaction as the Agenda replacement.

primary_key.name: pk_event_agenda_mutation_operation
primary_key.reason: Self scope plus operation id is the database arbiter for Agenda mutation replay.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_agenda_mutation_operation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Operation idempotency is scoped to an existing authenticated self Person.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_agenda_mutation_operation_event_ref_event_expectation
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: The technical receipt refers to the canonical Event whose internal Agenda was changed.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_agenda_mutation_operation_resulting_revision
check_constraints.reason: Each accepted aggregate mutation advances exactly one revision.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_agenda_mutation_operation_accepted_agenda_parts
check_constraints.reason: Keep operation replay snapshot within the same Agenda cardinality bound.

indexes.name: pk_event_agenda_mutation_operation
indexes.reason: Indexed idempotency arbiter for self-scoped Agenda operations.

state_history.current_binding: Receipts preserve accepted technical operation results; event_agenda_current is the aggregate current revision.
state_history.chronology: created_at is authoritative operation chronology; expected/resulting revisions are concurrency sequence values.
state_history.immutability_policy: Receipts are insert-once and replay-only. No runtime DML grant is exposed.

lifecycle.retention: Retained to preserve safe replay and conflict semantics across later Agenda revisions.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; B03-D downgrade refuses while mutation receipts exist.

obligations: same operation id and same intent replays the accepted revision and Agenda snapshot
same operation id with changed intent conflicts
accepted replacement advances revision exactly once
runtime has no direct receipt DML authority
